name: nexo
description: Nexo Salud: comparador y cotizador de planes de Isapre

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w android && npm run typecheck -w ios
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w api-client && npm run test -w backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
